items.name: ShapedArraySyntax
items.summary: Whether a shaped-array type was constructed using native (`Tensor[N, M]`) or jaxtyping (`Float[Tensor, "N M"]`) syntax. Controls display rendering and enables diagnostic checks (e.g., mixing both syntaxes in one function).

methods.signature: fn recurse<'a>(&'a self, f: &mut dyn FnMut(&'a To))

methods.signature: fn recurse_mut(&mut self, f: &mut dyn FnMut(&mut To))

methods.name: type_eq
methods.signature: fn type_eq(&self, other: &Self, ctx: &mut equality::TypeEqCtx) -> bool

items.name: broadcast_shapes
items.summary: Compute the broadcasted shape of two tensor shapes following NumPy/PyTorch broadcasting rules: - Dimensions are aligned from right to left - Each dimension must either match or one of them must be 1 - Missing dimensions are treated as 1

items.name: is_tuple_carrier_shape_middle
items.summary: Detects a tuple-carrier shape variable occupying the variadic middle of an unpacked shape.

items.name: shape_to_tuple_carrier
items.summary: Convert an `IntTuple` into the equivalent tuple-carrier `Type`.

items.name: shape_to_tuple_carrier_arg
items.summary: Convert a projected tuple-carrier shape back to the class type argument.

items.name: type_to_dim
items.summary: Convert a `Type` into an internal shape dimension, accepting only types that form a valid `Int` dimension. Returns `None` for anything else, so callers fail cleanly instead of treating an unrelated type as a dimension.

methods.name: all_literal
methods.summary: Check if all dimensions are literal (concrete integers) Returns false for variadic shapes

methods.name: as_concrete
methods.summary: Get the concrete dims if this is a concrete shape.

methods.name: as_literals
methods.summary: Extract literal dimension values if all are literal Returns None for variadic shapes

methods.name: dims
methods.summary: Get dims as a Vec for concrete shapes, panics for unpacked This is used by meta-shape code that doesn't support variadic shapes yet

methods.name: dims_mut
methods.summary: Get a mutable reference to concrete dims (for meta-shape operations) Panics if called on Unpacked shape

methods.name: dims_slice
methods.summary: Get a slice of dimensions (only valid for concrete shapes)

methods.name: fmt_jaxtyping
methods.summary: Format the shape using jaxtyping syntax (space-separated, no parens for scalar).

methods.name: from_shape_arg_or_tuple_carrier
methods.summary: Recover a whole shape from either an `IntTuple` shape argument or a tuple carrier that has already passed annotation validation.

methods.name: from_shape_arg_type
methods.summary: Recover a shape from an `IntTuple` shape argument, canonicalizing it via `normalize`. Returns `None` for any other type.

methods.name: from_types
methods.summary: Create a concrete shape from dimension types, recovering invalid dimensions to `int`.

methods.name: get_dim
methods.summary: Get a dimension by index (only for concrete shapes)

methods.name: materialize
methods.summary: Materialize gradual dimensions and rank in place (see `Int::materialize`). The `Unpacked` middle is a `Type` and is materialized by the generic `Type::materialize` traversal that recurses into it.

methods.name: normalize
methods.summary: Rebuild this shape through the canonical constructors.

methods.name: normalize_dim
methods.signature: fn normalize_dim(&self, dim: i64) -> Result<usize, ShapeError>
methods.summary: Normalize a dimension index to handle negative indices

methods.name: to_shape_arg_type
methods.summary: Wrap this shape as the `IntTuple` type argument used to carry a whole shape (e.g. the `S` in `Tensor[S]`).

methods.name: to_tuple_type
methods.summary: Project this shape to the ordinary tuple type it denotes.

methods.signature: fn type_eq(&self, other: &Self, ctx: &mut equality::TypeEqCtx) -> bool

methods.name: unpacked
methods.signature: fn unpacked(prefix: Vec<Int>, middle: Type, suffix: Vec<Int>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create and canonicalize a variadic shape with fixed dimensions around its middle.

methods.name: unpacked_from_types
methods.signature: fn unpacked_from_types(prefix: Vec<Type>, middle: Type, suffix: Vec<Type>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create an unpacked shape from a boundary that represents fixed dimensions as `Type`s.

items.name: ShapedArrayType
items.summary: A class instance with shape information. Example: Tensor[[2, 3]] represents a 2x3 tensor Example: Tensor (no brackets) represents a shapeless tensor (`IntTuple`)

methods.name: is_shapeless
methods.summary: Returns true if the shaped array has no shape information. (represented as a gradual `IntTuple`)

methods.name: materialize_inline_shape
methods.summary: Materialize gradual dimensions of an inline shape (see `Int::materialize`). `TupleCarrier` shapes store their dimensions as `Type` arguments on `base_class`, so they are materialized by the generic `Type::materialize` traversal instead.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(base_class: ClassType, shape: IntTuple) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a shaped-array type with shape information (defaults to Native syntax).

methods.name: rank
methods.summary: Returns rank if shape is concrete, None for variadic/shapeless
